text: Ollama generation can return punctuation entries in sentence tokens; tune the enrichment prompt or add deterministic post-processing so new Rust output keeps tokens word-only and validates on first pass.
sentences generate shows no progress while waiting on a local Ollama request; add timing/progress output around model readiness, prompt send, response received, validation, and write/report steps.

sentences plan reports all legacy Python output as missing lineage, so the first Rust generation will duplicate existing cards; add clearer CLI wording or a migration/ignore strategy before large real runs.
Validation failures are stored and printed as one large multi-line error string; make run reports structure errors by sentence/index/field so failed model batches are easier to inspect.
Live translategemma:12b generation took about 4.7 minutes for one 5-sentence batch; decide whether to reduce batch size, add a timeout flag, or switch to a faster model before large runs.

Before committing real Rust-generated sentence batches, add a quick Hindi quality review step for accepted output; the first smoke batch is structurally valid but should still be checked for teaching quality and tag usefulness.

Improve learner meanings for क्या / kyā when it functions as a yes/no question particle. Example from output/sentences/complete_hindi_chapter_02_sentences_batch_06.json item 0007: Hindi 'क्या ये शब्दकोश भी महँगे हैं?' / Roman 'kyā ye śabdkoś bhī mahãge haĩ?' / English 'Are these dictionaries also expensive?' Current word meaning says 'what', but learner-facing meaning should indicate yes/no question marker in this context.

Improve staged sentence generation consistency for word-breakdown batches. Live test for output/sentences/complete_hindi_chapter_02_sentences_batch_07.json failed in runs/sentences/1778858343001118000_ollama_translategemma_12b.json: word-breakdown-from-translation preserved IDs but emitted invalid YAML with stray commas after quoted punctuation entries and attached punctuation like hai?. Consider per-item word-breakdown calls, stricter JSON-only output, or a repair/extraction layer before validation.

Improve literal stage quality checks so model cannot copy Hindi as the literal English rendering. Example from output/sentences/complete_hindi_chapter_02_sentences_batch_07.json item 0012: Hindi 'नहीं नहीं, वह शब्दकोश नहीं है, रामायण है!' / Roman 'nahī̃ nahī̃, vah śabdkoś nahī̃ hai, rāmāyaṇ hai!' / English 'No no, it's not a dictionary, it's the Ramayan!' Current literal copied Hindi instead of giving English structure.
